_comment: World-level switches and the scattered footprint (prompt 12, docs/scatter.md). Every number and seed salt is here. Metres unless stated.
_footprint_note: scatter = the new ocean of sand with scattered land masses of every size; mapped = prompt 11 exactly (the 104 mapped ellipses plus the seeded islands of islands.json)
_materials_note: new = 3-block sandstone skin over stone, tough rock grows out of the sandstone (sandstone foot fading into stone, andesite bands); old = prompt 11 block choice exactly
_dune_note: scales the dune surface above the sand level (63): everything the dune function adds (dunes, hills, dune mountains). 1.0 = the dunes of prompt 11 exactly. Read when the world loads: change it and restart the server / reopen the world

scatter._extent_note: the footprint is generated for |x|, |z| <= extent_half and is a pure function of the seed; past it the sand goes on without land (the per-ellipse tables of the coast, relief and tough models need a finite list)
scatter._gap_note: nominal distance between two separate land masses (ellipse to ellipse, before the coast noise); the coast model's gap guard then keeps at least 100 m of sand after the noise
scatter._density_note: slow noise sets the chance of a candidate: mult = clamp(1 + gain * noise, 0, max_mult), so some regions are crowded and some nearly bare
scatter._lobe_note: centres of the lobes of a large or two-lobe mass are lobe_overlap times the sum of their semi-major axes apart (0.5 would just touch end to end); smaller = fatter necks
scatter._islets_note: role for extra tiny islets between the masses; off by default (per_cell 0), not tuned
scatter._kinds_note: regional noise sampled at the centre of a land mass: below t_low kind 1, between kind 2, above t_high kind 3 (about a third each); satellites inherit their parent's kind; the spawn island is kind 0
